notes: Per-proposition content-rights matrix (control-13, ADR 0008/0010). Every proposition (survey question) shown in the app has its wording adapted from, and its party-vote positions computed from, a LOCKED They Vote For You API v1 snapshot (data/snapshots/tvfy/<election>/v<version>/). This register records, per election, the content-rights class that governs those propositions and the OpenAustralia Foundation (OAF) content-permission position. scripts/check-proposition-rights.mjs (blocking, Data CI group) proves every proposition maps to a locked snapshot policy and to a defined rights class, so no proposition can ship without a settled content-rights position. The class must match the rights register's vote-positions domain (data/rights/rights-classes.json). Approval of this matrix is recorded as EV-TVFY-SNAPSHOT-LOCK in docs/legal/control-register.json.

elections.oafPermissionBasis: Proposition wording is How2Vote's editorial adaptation of They Vote For You policy descriptions, and party positions are computed by How2Vote from They Vote For You member agreement figures, all obtained from the They Vote For You API v1 under the ODbL and published under the ODbL with ODbL attribution. No separate OpenAustralia Foundation content permission is required. National Digital's contributions are additionally licensed under the DbCL 1.0.
